name: mjfork
description: Footer and pane tools for Claude Code sessions, and a prompt-cache timer with handoff notes.

plugins.name: cockpit
plugins.description: Everything for running long sessions in one install: turn-mode, ctx-bar, ctx-heavy, herdr-jump and cache-timer. Four of them need herdr; cache-timer does not. Has no code of its own.

plugins.name: turn-mode
plugins.description: How a turn ends, per session: async (summary, then a Needs-you ask or possible next steps), real-time (just ends) or agentic (one status line for the driving agent); injected with the prompt when it changes; a footer toggle left of the heaviest sessions

plugins.name: ctx-bar
plugins.description: Color-coded bar at the bottom of the footer's right-hand block, showing what fills the context window by tool; hover a segment for its biggest chunks

plugins.name: ctx-heavy
plugins.description: Second footer line under herdr-jump: your herdr sessions, wherever they are, each with its context size and prompt cache time left (from cache-timer), click one to go there; settings pick what a row shows and whether the biggest or the closest to expiring come first

plugins.name: herdr-jump
plugins.description: Footer label with the current herdr pane (e.g. herdr w8:p2); /jump takes you to a pane (a picker of workspace › tab › pane with type-to-filter, or /jump <pane id | workspace | words>); /needs-me (or the footer ⚑ count) opens the list of agents waiting on you, /needs-me-next jumps to the first one; /jump-back returns to the previous pane

plugins.name: cache-timer
plugins.description: Footer countdown of the main prompt cache (yellow near expiry, red once expired); a confirm card before a prompt re-sends an expired cache at full price; optionally writes a handoff note shortly before the cache expires (off by default), so a new session can resume from it; writes each pane's cache state for cache-state.sh
